source.title: Symplectic and inverse spectral geometry of integrable systems: a glimpse and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as one zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 7742441. Local workflow resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identifies the exact work title, year 2023, DOI 10.1016/j.topol.2023.108577, and publisher URL https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0166864123001712.

Readable full text could not be recovered within the bounded pass. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/7742441 returned a Cloudflare challenge/403 once and later local DNS resolution failed for zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, oai.zbmath.org, doi.org, and www.sciencedirect.com. Browser inspection of the ScienceDirect DOI target confirmed the same title and DOI but only exposed an article preview with purchase-PDF access, not a full-text artifact. Exact-title and DOI searches returned the ScienceDirect preview, author publication listings, and citing/reference pages, but no confirmed readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source.

No document map was created because no readable full-text PDF or full HTML primary source was available. The visible publisher preview was treated as insufficient for extraction under the source adequacy gate.

Access-failure classification: blocked_or_challenged for the original zbMATH page, network_or_dns_failure for local API/DOI/publisher fetches, and paywalled_or_restricted for the ScienceDirect article preview. No questions were accepted because extracting from metadata, abstract text, snippets, or a publisher preview without the complete problem statements would violate the source adequacy and evidence completeness gates.
